F1.value_zh: 只提供“数字素养与 AI 通识课堂”所述任务；不替代法定审批、专业判断或人工终决。
F1.value_en: Provides only the stated Digital literacy and AI general knowledge task; never replaces approval, professional judgement or human final decision.

F2.value_zh: 最少报名信息，不以画像分层

F3.value_zh: 建议由“人工讲师/志愿者”执行现场停止或结果复核，并留下责任记录。
F3.value_en: The final listed responsible role stops or reviews the service and records accountability.

F4.value_zh: 误判、故障、投诉、人工接管与处置结果均为定期答卷必填项；不得只报成功。
F4.value_en: Errors, faults, complaints, human takeover and resolution are mandatory; success-only reporting is prohibited.

F5.value_zh: 须在 G0 先登记非 AI 基线，再比较任务完成、时间、费用、可达性与申诉。
F5.value_en: Register the non-AI baseline at G0 before comparing completion, time, cost, accessibility and appeal.

F6.value_zh: 培训变营销、强制注册或无人工教学
F6.value_en: Marketing disguised as training, forced registration or no human teaching

H1.value_zh: 线下授课、纸质教材与现场答疑
H1.value_en: In-person teaching, paper materials and questions

H2.value_zh: 人工路径服务时段不短于 AI 路径。
H2.value_en: Human route hours are no shorter than AI-route hours.

H3.value_zh: 结果、时限与费用不低于 AI 路径。
H3.value_en: Outcome, turnaround and cost are no worse than the AI route.

H4.value_zh: 人工入口标识不小于、不隐于 AI 入口。
H4.value_en: Human-entry signage is neither smaller nor less visible than the AI entry.

H5.value_zh: 任一步骤可转人工且不重新排队或重复提交。
H5.value_en: A user may switch to a person at any step without re-queuing or resubmitting.
